question: Binoy starts from Point Y and drives 16 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn and drives 43 km, then turns right and drives 38 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 19 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 22 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Binoy starts from Point Y and drives 16 km towards the north.

He then takes a right turn and drives 43 km,

then turns right and drives 38 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 19 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 22 km and stops at Point Z.

So, He should drive **24 km towards the west** i in order to reach Point Y again.
